snippet.title: It's a wrap! - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It's a wrap! is a puzzle-platformer where you play as both a movie director and actor in Hollywood of the 80s.

Synchronize the scene's events, roll the camera and play out the script... if you can!




Credits to humanoide9000 (https://www.youtube.com/c/LuisHumanoide) for the music track.
